ex.s: Milwaukee, Wisconsin, is road testing a new way to keep winter roads ice-free -by spreading on them cheese brine, the salty liquid used to make soft cheeses, like mozzarella.

to affect or make sth affect, be known by, or used by more and more people 传播；散布；（使）流传
to cover, or to make sth cover, a larger and larger area （使）蔓延，扩散，散开

ex.s: Hoping to impress some talented actors to come and work for me for nothing, I spread some throws over the sofas and lit candles to make it seem a bit more “young professional”.

defs.def: to cause sb/sth to be in a number of different places 使分散；使分布
to cover a large area 延伸；伸展；扩张
to put a layer of a substance onto the surface of sth; to be able to be put onto a surface 涂；敷

ex.s: By spreading cheese brine on streets before adding a layer of rock salt, Milwaukee may be able to cut its rock salt use by 30 percent.

ex.s: Long before reading and writing became widely spread and available, oral storytelling had already been a form that the wisdom and knowledge of the people were passed down from elders to children.

defs.def: to stretch your body or arrange your things over a large area 伸展身体；摊开东西
to separate from other people in a group, to cover a larger area 散开
an increase in the amount or number of sth that there is, or in the area that is affected by sth 传播；散布；扩展；蔓延

ex.s: Plants can steal food from each other, or spread poisons to attack other plants.
